facts.fact: CIO Africa (2026-06-19) says Tanzania 'accelerates implementation of its Digital Economy Strategic Framework 2024-2034', described as a long-term plan to modernise public services, expand digital infrastructure, strengthen cybersecurity and enhance digital sovereignty; the stated period had not ended, and the article links no text. Text public: not stated

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication and Information Technology

systems.tiers: national; more than 24 million citizens registered

note: Class national rests on the article's description of the framework's scope (public services, infrastructure, cybersecurity, sovereignty); no adopting act or verb is given. The ministry's 2026/27 budget of about $84 million (94 per cent development) is the ministry's, not tied to the framework.
